items.source_text: Hey all, the churn model retrain finished last night. AUC went from 0.81 to 0.83 on the holdout, mostly from the new tenure features. I havent checked calibration yet, so please dont use the new scores for the retention campaign until I post the calibration plot tomorrow.

- 15:30 decision to roll back the 13:58 deploy

items.source_text: I recently had the privilege of attending the Experimentation Summit, and it was truly an eye-opening experience. The talk on CUPED variance reduction was hands down the most valuable hour of my year, and I came away with a renewed passion for rigorous testing. Excited to bring these learnings back to the team!
